title: ICC chamber issues Al-Masri warrant on murder and extermination allegations
affected_population: hostages held in the Gaza Strip
summary: The Chamber announced a warrant applying the reasonable-grounds threshold to alleged conduct on and after 7 October 2023.
claim: The Chamber stated that it found reasonable grounds to believe Al-Masri was responsible for the crimes against humanity of murder and extermination.
legal_characterization: Arrest-warrant allegations at the reasonable-grounds-to-believe threshold; not a conviction.
source_title: Situation in the State of Palestine: ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I issues warrant of arrest for Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri (Deif)
source_page: Web release, section headed “The warrant of arrest”
verification_notes: Verified against the ICC’s official warrant announcement and its stated reasonable-grounds threshold. The record does not treat the warrant as a conviction.
